steps.text: Route 21 (Surf from Cinnabar north to Pallet Town): Swimmers and Fishermen, Tangela in the grass patch.
Power Plant: Fly to Route 10 (Rock Tunnel Center), Surf down the river south of the tunnel entrance. Electabuzz, Magnemite, Voltorb inside; two of the item balls are Electrode (Lv.34) in disguise.
Zapdos Lv.50 at the back of the Power Plant (Electric/Flying, weak to Rock and Ice). One-time; save first.

Viridian Gym is open once you have 7 badges. Giovanni: Rhyhorn Lv.45, Dugtrio Lv.42, Nidoqueen Lv.44, Nidoking Lv.45, Rhyhorn Lv.50. Water and Grass (Surf, Ice Beam, Giga Drain); Lapras and Blastoise sweep. Dugtrio is fast — Surf it.
Gym Leader Giovanni. Earth Badge (all Pokémon obey) and TM26 Earthquake.
